title: Finance & Legal — Personal To-dos and Scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - finance/legal personal to-dos

Quick context: weekly catch-up with Legal ops on vendor redlines + close out Feb invoices. Mostly short notes to self and follow-ups.

TODAY (2026-03-01)
- Morning: skim invoices bucket (Drive + Bill.com) - prioritize >$25k.
- [ ] Check invoice INV-2026-045 (Vendor: DataGrid) - discrepancy: PO # vs SOW amount, finance approver notes mismatch. Ask procurement to confirm PO. (assigned to Ethan)
- [x] Quick call with Priya @ 10:30am - sync on renewal calendar for Mar renewals.
- [ ] Finish redlines for Acme Systems MSA (redline v3) - focus on IP/indemnity and data residency paragraph. Need example clause from Legal playbook. Link: CONFLUENCE: legal/templates/msas (see clause template: "data-residency-2024").
- [ ] Email procurement re: PO for INV-2026-045 + confirm expedite payment if needed.
- [ ] Add renewal reminders to Renewals sheet for: Loomia (renewal 2026-03-15), CloudLayer (auto-renews 2026-03-20) - check if we have termination notice window.

NOTES / THREADS
- Loomia renewal: draft negotiation points - ask for 30% discount for committed usage; legal: ask to remove auto-renewal clause or shorten notice period to 30 days. Action: draft email, send to product ops for usage numbers.
- CloudLayer: SOC2 SLA ask from Security - escalate to Solutions Eng for evidence. Procurement to request updated attestation from vendor.

INVOICES TO PRIORITIZE
1) INV-2026-045 (DataGrid) - hold until PO confirmed.
2) INV-2026-038 (InfraOne) - approved, schedule payment 2026-03-03.
3) INV-2026-047 (Consulting) - dispute line item for extra hours, check timesheets (see GH-PR-219 timesheet export).

CONTRACT REDLINES (PRIORITY)
- Acme Systems MSA v3 (high) - target finish by 2026-03-03.
  - Open questions: indemnity cap, export controls, subcontractor flowdown.
- Vendor: Loomia (SaaS) - negotiate auto-renew, data export clause, liability cap (medium).
- Partner: BrightPath reseller addendum - low priority, ops requested minimal changes.

RENEWALS CALENDAR (upcoming 30d)
- 2026-03-15 Loomia - assign to Natalie + Priya to review pricing.
- 2026-03-20 CloudLayer - procurement to confirm renewal terms.
- 2026-04-05 DataGrid support contract - FYI, likely renew if PO cleared.

REMINDERS / QUICK TASKS
- Add "check Bill.com exception queue" to recurring daily checklist.
- Follow up with LegalOps on template library update (deadline requested by SRE: 2026-03-10).
- Save finalized redline as PDF + upload to Contract Vault (Confluence/Contracts) and add Jira link to JIRA-FIN-78.
- Note to self: confirm approval path for >$50k invoices (VP finance + CFO) before scheduling payment.

MEETING NOTES (2/27 sync)
- Legal ops: we will standardize data residency clause for EMEA customers. Action: get approved clause from Security team.
- Procurement: working on vendor onboarding backlog; asked to prioritize SOC2 vendors.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Can we shorten Loomia notice period? Check earlier negotiation emails (thread: slack #vendor-negotiations ts: 1677500000.000150).
- Who owns the backup copy of redlined MSA after signatures? Legal ops or Contracts Vault? Confirm process.

REFERENCES / LINKS
- Confluence: billing/invoice-process
- Confluence: legal/templates/msas
- Jira: JIRA-FIN-78 (Loomia renewal)
- Bill.com: bill.com/company/inbox (internal)

TODAY'S QUICK NEXT STEPS
1) Email procurement re: DataGrid PO (cc Ethan).
2) Finish Acme redline v3 - find indemnity clause precedent in templates.
3) Update Renewals sheet with Loomia and CloudLayer details.
4) Triage Bill.com exceptions after lunch.

Random notes to self: keep redline comments short + cite playbook clause numbers; if vendor pushes on liability cap, escalate early to VP Finance.

---
